prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-13, before any full-suite result was read (GOALS D7/D8). Depth threshold D = 5. Primary endpoint, per class and overall: the share of cells that reach max depth D = 5 by T = 100,000 engine turns. Non-inferiority margin: 10 percentage points against the pristine C control (angband-e473-original), for A and for B. Descriptive only, not endpoints: deaths and their causes, max depth, max character level, first turn at each depth. For #183: B against A on survival (dead at T), max depth and max level, per class, and the causes of the deaths B adds.
